geometry.note: OpenStreetMap trace (rank 11), so confidence is capped at approximate even where the distance check passes. No numeric official figure for the LST-2/3/4 positions was found, so there is no check.
geometry.quote: The completion of the four telescopes marks a significant milestone

method: OpenStreetMap way 1263216284 (building=yes, name='Large-Sized-Teleskop', note='In Construction (3-24)', telescope:diameter=23, height=45), a closed 20-node polygon used verbatim. OSM does not number the three new LSTs, so which of LST-2, LST-3, LST-4 this is stays unstated. The 'In Construction (3-24)' tag dates from March 2024; CTAO announced on 15 October 2026 the inauguration of the LST sub-array and 'the completion of the four telescopes'.
name: Large-Sized Telescope (one of LST-2, LST-3, LST-4), OSM way 1263216284
notes: Drawn with its entity's status (CTAO is under construction). Per CTAO (2026-10-15) the four LSTs will now undergo commissioning and integration into CTAO operations. Backlog: the CTAO layout coordinates (as-requested, < 10 m shift) to number the three telescopes and check these footprints.

summary.plain: One of the three newest 23-metre Large-Sized Telescopes of the northern Cherenkov Telescope Array on La Palma, completed with the 2026 inauguration of the four-telescope LST sub-array.
